items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: And all this time Eddie Durham was in the band, Eddie Tompkins, my brother Keg Johnson, and we had one great hell of a band.

ctx.x: And then Ed Tompkins, and You, and Keg Johnson, your brother.

items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: we formed a clique, which was the two trumpets and myself and Budd Johnson ... That's when we all went into Jesse Stone's band

ctx.x: But you know who was with that band, was Eddie Tompkin, Paul Weston, because we formed a clique, which was the two trumpets and myself and Budd Johnson -- I mean, and Keg Johnson. And a guy named -- I can't think of his name, there was five of us. That's when we all went into Jesse Stone's band, the same way.
